name: Immerle
description: Your music, self-hosted, and it sings.

paths.name: AppData
paths.description: The database, settings, and the random auth secret that Immerle makes on first start.

paths.name: Music
paths.description: Your music library, mounted read-only from /mnt/cache/media/Music.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Web UI, API and Subsonic endpoint, published on host as 6108.

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: DATABASE_DSN
variables.description: Where the SQLite database file is saved, inside the data folder. Leave it as is.

variables.name: LIBRARY_DATA_DIR
variables.description: The folder where Immerle keeps its own data and settings. Leave it as /data.
